description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Vice Admiral S. S. Ranasinghe as the Head of the Sri Lanka Navy, w.e.f. 26.10.2017 and Vice Admiral T. J. L. Sinniah promoted to the rank of Admiral w.e.f. 25.10.2017 and retired him from the post w.e.f. 26.10.2017
reasoning: This gazette contains only government personnel changes (promotions, appointments, and retirements) of named individuals (Rear Admiral Sirimevan Sarathchandra Ranasinghe and Admiral Travis Jeremy Liyanaduru Sinniah) with basic titles only (Head of Sri Lanka Navy, Commander of Sri Lanka Navy). There are no detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes, making this a People Gazette.
